sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content: When you submit an enquiry we collect your name, email, phone number, project location, project type, indicative budget and the details you choose to share about your project.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use this information only to respond to your enquiry, schedule consultations and deliver our architecture and interior design services. We do not sell or rent your data.

sections.title: Project Imagery
sections.content: Photographs of completed projects are published only with the client's consent, and private details such as exact addresses are never disclosed.

sections.title: Data Security & Retention
sections.content: Data is stored securely and retained only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.content: For any privacy request, please write to the studio using the email address on our Contact page.

sections.title: Consultations
sections.content: Consultation requests are subject to availability. Scope, fees and deliverables for any commission are confirmed separately in a written agreement.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.content: All drawings, renders, photographs and text on this website are the property of the studio or used under licence, and may not be reproduced without permission.

sections.title: Information Only
sections.content: Content on this website is for general information and does not constitute professional advice for a specific site or project.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.content: The studio is not liable for decisions made solely on the basis of information published on this website.

sections.title: Governing Law
sections.content: These terms are governed by the laws of India, with jurisdiction in Jaipur, Rajasthan.
